## otakumode.com (Information)

- https://otakumode.com/otapedia/games/final_fantasy/mystic_quest -- story, dates, tags -- accessed 2026-10-17 (fetched by me, text pasted by user; Tokyo Otaku Mode's Otapedia, sections Story, Gameplay, Battle System, Characters)
  - Story: a very short summary (an unnamed continent with four regions, Foresta, Aquaria, Fireburg and Windia, whose fate rests on four crystals; Benjamin, in the ruins of his town, is told by an old man to obtain the four crystals and return them to the Focus Tower; the Dark King and the vile four drain the crystals)
    - agrees with the entry's description (Benjamin journeys to reclaim the stolen crystals and restore balance to the world)
    - the antagonist is a spoiler-level detail not copied
  - Release: Super Nintendo (Super Famicom) in 1992, called Final Fantasy USA in Japan, a spin-off simplified for wider audiences with an auto mode, action-adventure elements and no random encounters
    - modest reviews
    - consistent with the entry (1992-10-05, native) and its tags (RPG, Action-adventure)
    - directed by Kouzi Ide, written by Chihiro Fujioka, Yoshihiko Maekawa and Ted Woolsey
    - its Gameplay and Battle System sections are mechanics content, outside our scope
    - its Links section names only https://www.square-enix.com/
